candidates.explanation: The exclusion filter is `id: Not(Number(conditions.userId))`. It compares the session id with the user id instead of the id of the session to keep (`excludeId`). So the current session is not protected and is soft-deleted, and its next refresh returns 401. A different session whose id happens to equal the user id is spared. That matches the 'unrelated older session sometimes survives' symptom.

The Mongo variant has the same exclusion logic. If it builds its `_id: { $not: ... }` filter from `userId` instead of `excludeId`, it ends the current session too. This is less certain because the body is truncated in the snippet.

After a password change, this calls `sessionService.deleteByUserIdWithExclude`. If it passes the wrong value as the excluded session (not `userJwtPayload.sessionId`), the current session is deleted. The call site is truncated in the snippet, so this is a weaker candidate.

fix.description: Exclude the current session by its own id. Use `id: Not(Number(conditions.excludeSessionId))` (the 'keep this session' field in the conditions type), not `userId`. Make the same change in the document repository. Confirm that AuthService.update passes `userJwtPayload.sessionId` as the excluded id.

candidates.explanation: The exclusion filter is `id: Not(Number(conditions.userId))`. It compares the session id with the user id instead of the id of the session to keep (`excludeId`). So the current session is not protected and is soft-deleted, and its next refresh returns 401. A different session whose id happens to equal the user id is spared. That matches the 'unrelated older session sometimes survives' symptom.

The Mongo variant has the same exclusion logic. If it builds its `_id: { $not: ... }` filter from `userId` instead of `excludeId`, it ends the current session too. This is less certain because the body is truncated in the snippet.

After a password change, this calls `sessionService.deleteByUserIdWithExclude`. If it passes the wrong value as the excluded session (not `userJwtPayload.sessionId`), the current session is deleted. The call site is truncated in the snippet, so this is a weaker candidate.

fix.description: Exclude the current session by its own id. Use `id: Not(Number(conditions.excludeSessionId))` (the 'keep this session' field in the conditions type), not `userId`. Make the same change in the document repository. Confirm that AuthService.update passes `userJwtPayload.sessionId` as the excluded id.
